% A test for tex8web: a ~ in the text is a narrowed no-break space, and the
% spaces in verbatim text, alltt and \verbatiminput are left as they are.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{alltt,verbatim}
\begin{document}
Plain~text.

\begin{verbatim}
p  q   r
\end{verbatim}

\begin{alltt}
x  =  1   \emph{two}  three
\end{alltt}

\verbatiminput{test-verbatim.txt}
\end{document}
